title: TreviPay - B2B trade credit and invoicing network (acquired Apruve in 2022)
clean_text: TreviPay is a B2B payments and invoicing network with a 40-plus year legacy in trade credit (net terms), authorizing, clearing, and settling invoice-based transactions over an open-loop network that utilizes the Mastercard payment network. It enables B2B net terms programs for merchants in over 20 countries with support for 10+ currencies, and offers tiered solutions: a Private Network for large enterprise sellers wanting closed, branded trade credit networks; the TreviPay Network for mid-market companies needing instant trade credit without a branded solution; and a Small Business Supplier Network letting banks offer SMBs flexible payment terms. TreviPay acquired B2B credit company Apruve in December 2022 and now operates its product line.

meta.target: enterprise sellers through mid-market and SMB suppliers (via bank partners)
